episode_summary: In this episode, Paul Salter discusses the pitfalls of building success on the need for external validation. He emphasizes the importance of recalibrating ambition to avoid burnout and achieve sustainable fulfillment. The conversation provides actionable insights for high performers to shift their focus from proving their worth to finding personal purpose.
